All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Assignment
An assignment with a deadline.
AssignmentDialog
Dialog for adding or editing an assignment: title, due date, estimated hours, preferred block length and an optional course.
AssignmentManager
Use case 3, Plan an Assignment from a Deadline.
AssignmentPanel
Sidebar section for use cases 3 and 5: the assignment list with a progress bar per row and buttons to add, edit, delete, record progress and mark complete.
BaseManager
Shared plumbing for the managers: access to the in-memory DataStore, saving through LocalStorage, and a few input checks that every manager needs.
CalendarFilter
Search and filter conditions for the calendar.
CalendarItem
Anything that can be drawn on the calendar: a fixed Event or a generated StudyBlock.
CalendarManager
Use case 4, View, Search and Filter the Calendar.
CalendarView
Base class of the month and week views.
CalendarView.Hit
Painted item with its screen rectangle.
Course
A course is a name plus a color.
CourseCombo
Drop-down of courses with a leading "(no course)" entry and a color dot in front of every name.
CourseCombo.DotIcon
Small round color icon.
CourseDialog
Dialog for adding or editing a course: a name and a color chosen from a palette (or any color through the system color chooser).
CourseManager
Use case 1, Manage Courses.
CoursePanel
Sidebar section for use case 1: the course list with Add / Edit / Delete buttons.
DataStore
In-memory collections of all program data.
DemoData
Fills an empty data folder with a realistic sample semester so the beta can be demonstrated (and screenshotted) without typing everything in.
EnoughProcrastination
Entry point of the application core and the public API of Enough Procrastination.
Event
A fixed commitment such as a lecture or an appointment.
EventDialog
Dialog for adding or editing a fixed event: title, date, all-day switch, start and end time, and an optional course link.
EventManager
Use case 2, Manage Events.
EventManager.EventResult
Result of adding or editing an event: the event itself plus the re-planning results of any assignments whose blocks had to move.
Fields
Small factory for the input widgets used by the dialogs: date and time spinners, number spinners and a simple two-column form layout.
FilterBar
Search and filter controls for use case 4: keyword, course, type and a date range, plus a Clear button that brings the whole calendar back.
FormDialog
Modal dialog skeleton with a heading, a form area and OK / Cancel buttons.
ItemType
The two kinds of entries that can appear on the calendar.
LocalStorage
Saves and loads the DataStore as plain text files in one folder.
Main
Program entry point.
MainFrame
The application window.
MonthView
Six-week month grid.
PlanResult
Outcome of one planning run for an Assignment: the study blocks that were placed and the number of hours that did not fit before the deadline.
ProgressDialog
Dialog for use case 5.
ProgressManager
Use case 5, Track Assignment Progress.
ProgressReport
Snapshot of an assignment's progress after a change: estimated, completed and remaining hours, plus any shortage left by re-planning the remainder.
ScheduleManager
The planner.
StudyBlock
One block of study time generated for an Assignment.
UiTheme
Colors, fonts and small drawing helpers shared by the calendar views.
ValidationException
Thrown by the managers when user input breaks one of the rules in the requirements (blank or duplicate course name, event that ends before it starts, progress larger than the estimate, and so on).
WeekView
Seven-day week grid with an hour axis.
